تصافحت (form VI)
# تَصَافَحْتُ (taṣāfaḥtu) /ta.sˤaː.faħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# تَصَافَحْتَ (taṣāfaḥta) /ta.sˤaː.faħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# تَصَافَحْتِ (taṣāfaḥti) /ta.sˤaː.faħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# تَصَافَحَتْ (taṣāfaḥat) /ta.sˤaː.fa.ħat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
